core: Transition and heavy metal ion transport and detoxification
qualifier: copper, manganese and cadmium (with metallothionein)
name: Copper, manganese and cadmium transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern transport, homeostasis or detoxification of copper, manganese, cadmium or cobalt ions, which separates the theme from the iron/heme and zinc confusables and, through cadmium detoxification, from the MTF1 metal-response confusable.

qualifier: serotonin plus sympathoadrenal development
name: Monoamine synthesis and degradation with sympathoadrenal development
rationale: Members cover biosynthesis and MAO/COMT degradation of serotonin and catecholamines plus adrenal, sympathetic ganglion and noradrenergic neuron development, unlike confusables centred on catecholamine reuptake transporters, BH4 cofactor synthesis or organic cation transport.

qualifier: ISG15 conjugation and control of viral replication
name: Interferon-stimulated ISG15 and host control of viral replication
rationale: Members combine the interferon-alpha/ISG15 conjugation programme with host processes that perturb viral genome replication, protein levels and release, whereas confusables are type I interferon signalling/OAS/PKR without the viral-replication terms or viral life-cycle terms without ISG15.

qualifier: serine, glycine, proline and vitamin B6
name: Serine, glycine, proline and vitamin B6 metabolism
rationale: Members cover serine, glycine, proline, glyoxylate and aspartate-family amino acid metabolism together with pyridoxal phosphate (vitamin B6) activation, distinguishing it from aromatic amino acid/BH4, sulfur amino acid and molybdenum cofactor confusables.

qualifier: eIF5A hypusination
name: Polyamine metabolism and transport with eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Members concern ODC-regulated putrescine, spermidine and spermine synthesis, interconversion, oxidation and transport plus spermidine-derived hypusination of eIF5A promoting translation elongation, unlike the methionine salvage, tryptophan/NAD and other protein-modification confusables.

qualifier: intestinal, hepatic and pancreatic
name: Intestinal, hepatic and pancreatic epithelial lineage differentiation
rationale: Members are HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium programmes, intestinal stem cell and epithelial maintenance terms and pancreatic progenitor lineages, separating it from definitive endoderm, reproductive/mammary gland and beta-cell insulin secretion confusables (adrenal development and leukocyte migration are outliers).

qualifier: phagocytosis and antibody-dependent cytotoxicity
name: Fc-gamma receptor signaling, phagocytosis and antibody-dependent cytotoxicity
rationale: Members are activating and inhibitory Fc-gamma receptor signalling, FCGR-driven phagocytic cup formation, ADCC and type II hypersensitivity, unlike the Fc-epsilon/mast cell, BCR and B cell inhibitory confusables.

qualifier: enhanced TCR signaling and IL-2 production
name: TCR-driven T cell activation and IL-2 production
rationale: All three members concern T cell activation through positive regulation of TCR signalling and IL-2 production, whereas confusables cover T cell differentiation, co-inhibition and proximal TCR phosphorylation or B cell terms.

core: Mitochondrial branched-chain amino acid and lysine catabolism
qualifier: lipoate- and biotin-dependent enzymes and their deficiencies
name: Branched-chain amino acid and lysine catabolism with lipoate/biotin cofactors
rationale: Members cover leucine, isoleucine, valine and lysine catabolism via lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and biotin-dependent carboxylases with their inborn errors (MSUD, organic acidemias, biotinidase deficiency), unlike TCA cycle, serine/B6 and CoA/PDH regulation confusables.

qualifier: maple syrup urine disease
name: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and maple syrup urine disease
rationale: All members are reactions or defects of the BCKDH, PDH, OGDH and OADH multienzyme complexes, chiefly MSUD variants, while confusables add biotin carboxylases, lipoylation, glycine/lysine catabolism or CoA biosynthesis instead of PDH/OGDH.

qualifier: vitamin D and vitamin K with protein gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism with protein gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin D hydroxylation and its CYP defects and vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors, distinguishing it from phosphate/mineralization, retinoic acid and vitamin E/ubiquinol confusables.

qualifier: oxidized LDL-driven foam cell formation
name: Apoptotic cell clearance and oxidized LDL-driven foam cell formation
rationale: Members cover phosphatidylserine-mediated recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells and neutrophils plus oxLDL response, cholesterol storage, foam cell differentiation and amyloid-beta clearance, unlike microglial activation and scavenger receptor class confusables.

qualifier: UV, phorbol ester and nitric oxide
name: AP-1 immediate-early response to UV and phorbol ester
rationale: Members are AP-1/NR4A immediate-early and TNF/NF-kB programmes triggered by UV, phorbol ester, nitric oxide and growth factors, whereas confusables are TAK1/JNK/p38 kinase cascades or KRAS/FOSL proliferation programmes lacking the UV and phorbol ester responses.

qualifier: APOBEC3G DNA cytidine deamination
name: APOBEC3G DNA cytidine deamination in HIV-1 restriction
rationale: Members concern APOBEC3G-mediated DNA cytidine deamination restricting HIV-1 reverse transcription, its Vif-mediated degradation and clearance of foreign nucleic acid, distinguishing it from HIV life-cycle, RNA editosome and somatic hypermutation confusables.

core: Antigen-presenting cell to T cell activation
qualifier: costimulation and dendritic cell differentiation
name: APC-T cell costimulation and dendritic cell differentiation
rationale: Members combine TCR-MHC contact and costimulation driving CD4 T cell proliferation with regulation of dendritic cell differentiation and activation, unlike confusables of negative T cell regulation, DC/monocyte surface signatures or NK inhibition.

core: Actin cytoskeleton and cell shape regulation
qualifier: filopodia, Rho effectors (RHOF, citron) and EPHB signaling
name: Filopodium assembly and cell-shape polarity via Rho effectors
rationale: Members regulate filopodia, actin localization, cell-shape polarity and microtubule stability through RHOF, citron kinase and EPHB signalling, unlike confusables about dendrite/postsynaptic structure or lamellipodial motility and ROCK/PAK effectors.

core: Plasma membrane neutral amino acid transport
qualifier: SLC6A19 and Hartnup disorder
name: SLC6A19 neutral amino acid transport and Hartnup disorder
rationale: Members concern plasma-membrane uptake of neutral amino acids such as glycine and tryptophan and SLC6A19 defects causing Hartnup disorder, separating it from cationic/branched amino acid, oligopeptide and proline/iminoglycinuria transport confusables.

qualifier: embryonic heart morphogenesis with BMP signaling
name: Embryonic heart and vascular development with BMP signaling
rationale: Members span heart tube, chamber, valve, septum, conduction system, cardiomyocyte and endocardial development plus vascular/endothelial differentiation and BMP-SMAD signalling, unlike smooth muscle phenotypic switching, gastrulation, HOX patterning and cardiac adaptation confusables.

qualifier: assembly/disassembly and inositol phosphate transport
name: Nuclear pore complex assembly and inositol phosphate nucleocytoplasmic transport
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore complex assembly, mitotic disassembly and reformation and NPC-mediated transport of inositol phosphates and Rev, unlike confusables about ribosome/RNA export, nuclear envelope reformation or regulated protein import/export.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signaling
qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptors
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: All members are growth hormone, prolactin or leptin receptor signalling, distinguishing it from body-growth/IGF, thyroid hormone, GPCR growth-hormone-secretion and erythropoietin/thrombopoietin confusables.

qualifier: Fc and complement receptor regulation, neutrophil degranulation
name: Fc and complement receptor regulation of myeloid inflammatory activation
rationale: Members cover neutrophil/monocyte/macrophage inflammatory activation and degranulation regulated by Fc receptor, complement receptor and SIRP signalling with ADCC and hypersensitivity, unlike confusables centred on formyl peptide chemotaxis, respiratory burst killing, myeloid expression modules or FCGR phagocytosis.

qualifier: ICOS-driven Tfh help and memory B cells
name: Tfh-germinal center B cell interaction and B cell memory
rationale: Members are Tfh differentiation with ICOS costimulation, germinal center B cell differentiation and memory B cell signatures, unlike confusables about lymphoid tissue activation, plasma cell differentiation or B cell homeostasis.

qualifier: white, brown and beige fat with thermogenesis
name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members regulate white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation, adipose tissue development, PPAR signalling and cold/diet-induced thermogenesis, whereas confusables concern LXR-driven lipogenesis, triglyceride/lipid droplet handling and fatty acid transport.

qualifier: pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism of pyrimidines and deoxyribonucleotides, distinguishing it from purine de novo synthesis, ADA/PNP defects and nucleoside monophosphate phosphorylation confusables.

qualifier: protection from deadenylation with translational enhancement
name: mRNA stabilization against deadenylation and translational enhancement
rationale: All three members stabilize mRNAs (coding-region-determinant binding, inhibition of deadenylation-dependent decay) or promote their cytoplasmic translation, unlike confusables about miRNA silencing, ARE-mediated destabilization, stress granules or decapping decay.
